class.name: LocalDynamicGI3D
class.brief_description: Local-space adapter around HDDAGI for a descendant hierarchy.
class.description: [LocalDynamicGI3D] registers a local GI domain whose voxel/probe bounds are computed from descendant [GeometryInstance3D] contributors plus [member extend]. Ownership is hierarchical: only descendants belong to this Local GI. [b]Note:[/b] This node currently performs scene plumbing and editor bounds visualization only. Local HDDAGI runtime evaluation is not implemented yet. [b]Note:[/b] [LocalDynamicGI3D] is only supported in the Forward+ rendering method.

method.name: get_geometry_contributors
method.description: Returns descendant [GeometryInstance3D] nodes with [constant GeometryInstance3D.GI_MODE_STATIC] or [constant GeometryInstance3D.GI_MODE_DYNAMIC]. These contribute to Local bounds and later Local voxelization.

method.name: get_lights
method.description: Returns descendant [Light3D] nodes collected for this Local domain.

method.name: get_local_bounds
method.description: Returns the current Local-space bounds after merging contributor AABBs and expanding by [member extend].

method.name: get_local_dynamic_gi_rid
method.description: Returns the RenderingServer RID used to register this Local domain.

method.name: get_receive_only_geometry
method.description: Returns descendant [GeometryInstance3D] nodes with [constant GeometryInstance3D.GI_MODE_DISABLED]. They can receive Local GI but do not contribute to bounds or voxelization.

method.name: update_local_data
method.description: Recollects descendants, recomputes Local bounds, and updates the RenderingServer registration.

members.member: Distance used later to blend Local and Global GI near the Local bounds. Stored in V0; shading blend is not implemented yet.
If [code]false[/code], this Local domain stays registered but is ignored when selecting active Local slots.
Margin added to the merged descendant contributor AABB on each side.
